programme.title: 烈焰 / Burning Flames Episode 18
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 赴山海 / The Journey of Legend Episode 21
programme.desc: 肖明明曾是一名酷爱武侠小说、意气风发、充满正义感的少年。可步入社会后，现实磨平了他的棱角，逐渐成了一介怂人，如今只靠上网写武侠小说寄托自己的侠心。适逢公司研发一款沉浸式科技魔典写作系统，该系统在输入小说大纲后，可将使用者投射为故事主角，并根据使用者的行动补全故事，生成小说。作为写手，肖明明以小说男主角萧秋水的视角游历了一次武林世界。An author enters his novel as character Xiao Qiu Shui, getting caught in martial arts conflicts. After finding a system while seeking a manual, he must become the ultimate martial master to go home.

programme.title: 蛮好的人生 / A Better Life Episode 11
programme.desc: 三十九岁的保险从业人员胡曼黎在以为自己即将迎接人生巅峰之时，却同时失去了婚姻和工作。竞争对手暗中作梗，胡曼黎惨遭公司开除，而始作俑者竟是二十八岁的薛晓舟。胡曼黎在与薛晓舟几番交手后，他们逐渐从误解到相互认同，胡曼黎决定不计前嫌和薛晓舟联手合作，从头再来。薛晓舟成长为保险业界不容小觑的金牌销冠，胡曼黎也决定回归自己的事业主场。 Hu Man Li, a thirty-nine-year-old insurance practitioner, lost her marriage and job at the same time when she thought she was about to reach the peak of her life. programme.title: 天赐的声音 5 / The Treasured Voice 5 Episode 8
programme.desc: 《天赐的声音》第五季强势回归，节目邀请了十二至十五位歌手担任音乐合伙人，并由他们自行进行两两配对演唱；如果合伙人数量为单数，则最终会有一名歌手在该集节目轮空。在每轮歌曲演唱后，声音鉴赏团成员会在已演唱的歌曲中共同选出待定金曲，最终获得推荐金曲的搭档将分别担任下一期的队长，带领本队的三对歌手进行歌曲表演并角逐金曲称号。从第二阶段起，每期均会由在场观看录制的两百位观众额外选出一首人气金曲。

programme.title: 我的女儿孝心 / Live Your Own Life Episode 79
programme.desc: 该剧讲述的是内心温暖、为了家人牺牲自己生活的李孝心开始珍惜自己，想要摆脱折磨自己的“吸血虫”似的家人，独立找寻属于自己的人生的故事。When her father abandons her, a young woman supports her family. One day, she decides to pursue her own dreams and wishes by living independently.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 849
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 一城一味第四季 ·巴蜀关东 / One City One Taste S4. Spice and Snow Episode 2
programme.desc: 《一城一味·巴蜀关东》是一部以巴蜀、关东两地特色风味为指引的纪录片，聚焦成都、自贡、眉山、哈尔滨、沈阳、大连等极具美食、人文、自然特色的城市，以深入探寻美食江湖中的“三重境界”—食材江湖的鲜活本味、做法江湖的独门技艺、烟火江湖的人情温度为主。“One City One Taste S4· Spice and Snow” takes China Cheng Du as the starting point, and branch out to other surrounding provinces such as Harbin, Shen Yang, Da Lian. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 849
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 一城一味第四季 ·巴蜀关东 / One City One Taste S4. Spice and Snow Episode 2
programme.desc: 《一城一味·巴蜀关东》是一部以巴蜀、关东两地特色风味为指引的纪录片，聚焦成都、自贡、眉山、哈尔滨、沈阳、大连等极具美食、人文、自然特色的城市，以深入探寻美食江湖中的“三重境界”—食材江湖的鲜活本味、做法江湖的独门技艺、烟火江湖的人情温度为主。“One City One Taste S4· Spice and Snow” takes China Cheng Du as the starting point, and branch out to other surrounding provinces such as Harbin, Shen Yang, Da Lian. Marrying food and streets, markets, stores, chefs, and customers from different perspectives, the documentary presents the multi-dimensional tastes of Sichuan cuisine in a refreshing and never-seen-before manner.

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 850
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 一城一味第四季 ·巴蜀关东 / One City One Taste S4. Spice and Snow Episode 3
programme.desc: 《一城一味·巴蜀关东》是一部以巴蜀、关东两地特色风味为指引的纪录片，聚焦成都、自贡、眉山、哈尔滨、沈阳、大连等极具美食、人文、自然特色的城市，以深入探寻美食江湖中的“三重境界”—食材江湖的鲜活本味、做法江湖的独门技艺、烟火江湖的人情温度为主。“One City One Taste S4· Spice and Snow” takes China Cheng Du as the starting point, and branch out to other surrounding provinces such as Harbin, Shen Yang, Da Lian. Marrying food and streets, markets, stores, chefs, and customers from different perspectives, the documentary presents the multi-dimensional tastes of Sichuan cuisine in a refreshing and never-seen-before manner.

programme.title: 味道大师 / A Bite of Eternity Episode 3
programme.desc: 《味道大师》从“酸、甜、苦、辣、咸、鲜、臭、麻”八种基本口味出发，跳脱地域标签的展示化框架，更聚焦于口味背后的人与故事。这是一部将口味作为情感、身份、文化综合呈现的纪录片，也是一部借由美食观看口味如何影响国人生活及性格的作品。纪录片将走进二十余座城市，呈现百余道菜品，以八集故事构建中国人的口味交响乐。A documentary series that explores the rich culture of Chinese flavours. Each episode highlights how taste reflects personality, cultural identity, and lifestyle, creating a vivid journey through China’s culinary traditions.

programme.title: 有歌 2026 / Hit Song 2026
programme.desc: 《有歌2026》是一档音综巨作，以歌之名，寻找年度唱作人，开启音综新时代，让经典与流行交织，翻唱携原创共舞。知名音乐人歌手以及乐坛新生代通过节目给音乐重新赋予定义和生命，共同开启华语流行音乐的新篇章。 Music variety programme “Hit Songs 2026” seeks out the year's finest singer-songwriters. It weaves together classics and contemporary hits with original music pieces. Renowned musician-singers, alongside with the rising generation in the music scene, redefine and breathe new life into music through the show, collectively opening a new chapter for Chinese-language pop music.

programme.desc: 肖明明曾是一名酷爱武侠小说、意气风发、充满正义感的少年。可步入社会后，现实磨平了他的棱角，逐渐成了一介怂人，如今只靠上网写武侠小说寄托自己的侠心。适逢公司研发一款沉浸式科技魔典写作系统，该系统在输入小说大纲后，可将使用者投射为故事主角，并根据使用者的行动补全故事，生成小说。作为写手，肖明明以小说男主角萧秋水的视角游历了一次武林世界。An author enters his novel as character Xiao Qiu Shui, getting caught in martial arts conflicts. After finding a system while seeking a manual, he must become the ultimate martial master to go home.

programme.title: 有歌 2026 / Hit Song 2026
programme.desc: 《有歌2026》是一档音综巨作，以歌之名，寻找年度唱作人，开启音综新时代，让经典与流行交织，翻唱携原创共舞。知名音乐人歌手以及乐坛新生代通过节目给音乐重新赋予定义和生命，共同开启华语流行音乐的新篇章。 Music variety programme “Hit Songs 2026” seeks out the year's finest singer-songwriters. It weaves together classics and contemporary hits with original music pieces. Renowned musician-singers, alongside with the rising generation in the music scene, redefine and breathe new life into music through the show, collectively opening a new chapter for Chinese-language pop music.

programme.title: 一城一味第四季 ·巴蜀关东 / One City One Taste S4. Spice and Snow Episode 3
programme.desc: 《一城一味·巴蜀关东》是一部以巴蜀、关东两地特色风味为指引的纪录片，聚焦成都、自贡、眉山、哈尔滨、沈阳、大连等极具美食、人文、自然特色的城市，以深入探寻美食江湖中的“三重境界”—食材江湖的鲜活本味、做法江湖的独门技艺、烟火江湖的人情温度为主。“One City One Taste S4· Spice and Snow” takes China Cheng Du as the starting point, and branch out to other surrounding provinces such as Harbin, Shen Yang, Da Lian. Marrying food and streets, markets, stores, chefs, and customers from different perspectives, the documentary presents the multi-dimensional tastes of Sichuan cuisine in a refreshing and never-seen-before manner.

programme.title: 味道大师 / A Bite of Eternity Episode 3
programme.desc: 《味道大师》从“酸、甜、苦、辣、咸、鲜、臭、麻”八种基本口味出发，跳脱地域标签的展示化框架，更聚焦于口味背后的人与故事。这是一部将口味作为情感、身份、文化综合呈现的纪录片，也是一部借由美食观看口味如何影响国人生活及性格的作品。纪录片将走进二十余座城市，呈现百余道菜品，以八集故事构建中国人的口味交响乐。A documentary series that explores the rich culture of Chinese flavours. Each episode highlights how taste reflects personality, cultural identity, and lifestyle, creating a vivid journey through China’s culinary traditions.

programme.title: 末代厨娘 / The Last Cook Episode 8
programme.desc: 清末民初，民女容儿阴差阳错成为宫女后，与侍卫李琪结下渊源。因为对厨艺有悟性，所以颇受寿喜姑姑赏识，被其收为徒传授厨技。当寿喜被诬陷盗窃宫内珍宝而置于死地后，容儿不甘师傅冤死，与李琪并肩查案追回国宝，让幕后黑手受到应有的惩罚。最后，离开皇宫的容儿开了一家饭馆，人称“末代厨娘”。Set during the final years of the Qing Dynasty, this drama tells the story of Rong Er, a commoner who finds the opportunity to serve in the palace as a lady-in-waiting. programme.title: 桃花映江山 / The Princess' Gambit Episode 15
programme.desc: 《桃花映江山》讲述了祁国左相沈在野因一次政敌处心积虑的陷害，与北苑国和亲公主姜桃花相识，一个腹黑狠辣，一个狡猾伶俐，在波谲云诡的两朝时局之下，二人斗智斗勇、互相算计，在面对强敌的被迫合作中又暗生情愫，在面对国家与爱情的选择，他们突破重重阻碍，共谋定江山……。The drama tells the story of a fallen princess forced into a political marriage with a corrupt prime minister. programme.desc: 金泰珠是三姐弟中的老大，以医药学术专员为职，平日忙于医生和医院的沟通，以及医药文件的处理。身为长女的泰珠拥有一颗温暖的包容心，但脾气却很暴躁。尚俊则是泰珠的小学同学，他进入演艺圈二十年了，是个一线男演员。小学时曾跟泰珠告白的尚俊，个性阳光而且长相出众。素琳和建宇则是泰珠的妹妹和弟弟。究竟韩式家庭中的长男长女能否在家族期许下，背负生活重担，并顺利寻求婚姻的发展，最终找到人生幸福？Tae Ju is a salaried consulting medical doctor and planner for a medical documentary tv show. programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.desc: 三十九岁的保险从业人员胡曼黎在以为自己即将迎接人生巅峰之时，却同时失去了婚姻和工作。竞争对手暗中作梗，胡曼黎惨遭公司开除，而始作俑者竟是二十八岁的薛晓舟。胡曼黎在与薛晓舟几番交手后，他们逐渐从误解到相互认同，胡曼黎决定不计前嫌和薛晓舟联手合作，从头再来。薛晓舟成长为保险业界不容小觑的金牌销冠，胡曼黎也决定回归自己的事业主场。 Hu Man Li, a thirty-nine-year-old insurance practitioner, lost her marriage and job at the same time when she thought she was about to reach the peak of her life. programme.title: 赴山海 / The Journey of Legend Episode 24
programme.desc: 肖明明曾是一名酷爱武侠小说、意气风发、充满正义感的少年。可步入社会后，现实磨平了他的棱角，逐渐成了一介怂人，如今只靠上网写武侠小说寄托自己的侠心。适逢公司研发一款沉浸式科技魔典写作系统，该系统在输入小说大纲后，可将使用者投射为故事主角，并根据使用者的行动补全故事，生成小说。作为写手，肖明明以小说男主角萧秋水的视角游历了一次武林世界。An author enters his novel as character Xiao Qiu Shui, getting caught in martial arts conflicts. programme.title: 末代厨娘 / The Last Cook Episode 9
programme.desc: 清末民初，民女容儿阴差阳错成为宫女后，与侍卫李琪结下渊源。因为对厨艺有悟性，所以颇受寿喜姑姑赏识，被其收为徒传授厨技。当寿喜被诬陷盗窃宫内珍宝而置于死地后，容儿不甘师傅冤死，与李琪并肩查案追回国宝，让幕后黑手受到应有的惩罚。最后，离开皇宫的容儿开了一家饭馆，人称“末代厨娘”。Set during the final years of the Qing Dynasty, this drama tells the story of Rong Er, a commoner who finds the opportunity to serve in the palace as a lady-in-waiting. programme.title: Hollywood Weapons
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons Episode 2
programme.desc: In this iconic scene, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons Episode 3
programme.desc: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood – aka “Blondie” – saves Eli Wallach from the hangman's noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We recreate each scene and test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons Episode 4
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety. Using the same Beretta 92 handgun, we reconstruct the office glass and see if our host can break through.

programme.title: Decked Out Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Feel the wind whistle through Andrew and Shirley's lonely, empty backyard. Then stand back as Paul and the crew make room for a whole new deck experience, filled with curves, relaxing shaded spots, a hot tub, and even a grown-up sandbox to play in.

programme.title: Custom Built Season 1 Episode 22
programme.desc: Rethink Anthony and Maria's dated rec room with Paul, who builds a lounge, laundry space, dining area, and fireplace made for family fun. Then spot a surprise: Natasha and Prince's built-in baby-changing table that folds up into an art piece.

programme.title: Holmes on Homes Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Go full tilt on a repair to Jim and Helen's kitchen addition, where the floor has buckled after a single party. Follow Mike downstairs to secure the joists and add braces, and reflect on the importance of structural integrity as well as design.

programme.title: Holmes Makes It Right Season 1
programme.desc: Tackle a half-century of roof leaks that are plaguing the families on both sides of a semi-detached home. Conquer scorching heat as Mike and the crew deal with mould, lack of insulation, heat loss, and re-engineering a truss goof into a custom roof.

programme.title: Holmes Inspection Season 1 Episode 11
programme.desc: Make an emergency house call to Fred and Sara's diminutive, historical two-storey with Mike and the crew. Learn how gaping holes in their seemingly solid home inspection have led to a high-stakes repair mission for Damon and the construction team.

programme.title: Collector Showdown Season 1 Episode 25
programme.desc: Two passionate quirky quilters square off as they hook and strip their way to a fabulous mystery payoff.

programme.desc: We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. A celebrated footballer who lit up the English top-flight during his illustrious career; a winner of multiple domestic and European honours, he became a true legend of the Premier League era. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW Episode 34
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interviews with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: PL STORIES Episode 44
programme.desc: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, PL Stories spends time with Yakubu Aiyegbeni at Finchley Boxing Club, where he is forging a new path in the next chapter of his sporting life. We explore his growing passion for boxing and the discipline it demands, offering a fresh perspective on life after football. Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers.

programme.title: PL REWIND Episode 15
programme.desc: Gianfranco Zola signed for Chelsea in November 1996, aged 30. The Little Magician became a trailblazer as one of the Premier League's first genuine flair players, and by the time of his departure seven seasons later, he had established himself as an all-time great at Stamford Bridge.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS Episode 31
programme.desc: Fast-paced with music, ISO angles, and commentary, Netbusters offers an alternative review of every goal and key moment from the latest round of Premier League fixtures.

programme.title: Battle Of Okinawa In Color
programme.desc: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

programme.title: Shuttle Discovery's Last Mission
programme.desc: Celebrate the remarkable past of the Discovery space shuttle before it embarks on its final flight. Witness the emotionally charged mission, and see if this robust but fragile aircraft makes it to Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 9
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 10
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 8

programme.title: Destination China: Yunnan Episode 2
programme.desc: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnan's most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature's most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we witness nature's most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 3
programme.desc: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 4
programme.desc: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 5
programme.desc: This episode explores the world's most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 3
programme.desc: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 4
programme.desc: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Attenborough's Life In Colour Episode 3
programme.desc: Find out the stories behind the scientific research on animal colors - from robotic frogs wrestling with real-life counterparts, to spiders wearing eyeliner to attract mates.

programme.title: The Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

programme.title: The Rhino Orphanage Episode 2
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 5
programme.desc: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he's staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 6
programme.desc: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max's Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 7
programme.desc: Warren's next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa's largest game reserves, where he's staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 8
programme.desc: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 9
programme.desc: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 10
programme.desc: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He's taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

programme.title: Robert Downey Jr: High Altitude
programme.desc: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood… A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution… This is Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business
programme.desc: "Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business" is a documentary tracing the actor's rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

programme.title: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
programme.desc: With a work ethic like no other, it's hard to doubt Samuel L. Jackson's status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

programme.desc: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 2
programme.desc: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 3
programme.desc: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 4
programme.desc: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 5
programme.desc: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibia's Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 6
programme.desc: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives in his mum's home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 2
programme.desc: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 3
programme.desc: Adam's journey to explore China's history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

programme.title: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild Episode 2
programme.desc: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

programme.title: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild Episode 3
programme.desc: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

programme.title: Shuttle Discovery's Last Mission
programme.desc: Celebrate the remarkable past of the Discovery space shuttle before it embarks on its final flight. Witness the emotionally charged mission, and see if this robust but fragile aircraft makes it to Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Space Disasters
programme.desc: From the earliest days of space exploration to humankind's latest endeavors, risk is always part of the equation. But for the pioneers who were the first to put NASA's unpredictable technology and unproven designs to the test, the dangers were greater.

programme.title: Space Disasters Episode 2
programme.desc: It's one of the most challenging and dangerous phases of space exploration: bringing a spacecraft back to Earth. For decades, NASA and Soviet engineers and designers have struggled to build machines that can withstand the unforgivable heat and unthinkable speeds caused by re-entry into our atmosphere.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 Episode 3
programme.desc: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 Episode 4
programme.desc: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 4
programme.desc: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 5
programme.desc: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibia's Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 6
programme.desc: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

programme.title: Sea Hunters
programme.desc: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 2
programme.desc: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

programme.title: Sea Hunters Episode 3

programme.title: Aging In The Wild Episode 2
programme.desc: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

programme.title: Aging In The Wild Episode 3
programme.desc: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time he's joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 8
programme.desc: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 9
programme.desc: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 10
programme.desc: Adam Liaw's last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adam's ancestral home.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
programme.desc: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheep's head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

programme.title: Tom Cruise: Lights Camera Action
programme.desc: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

programme.title: Divas
programme.desc: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

programme.title: Divas Episode 2
programme.desc: Best known in Hollywood as “The Iron Butterfly” - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 3
programme.desc: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 4
programme.desc: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 5
programme.desc: This episode explores the world's most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 6
programme.desc: This episode explores how nature's toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to ‘talk' to each other.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 8
programme.desc: Examining nature's most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Zambia's Luangwa Valley is home to Africa's biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world's 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature's best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloo's conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the region's dark side.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1 Episode 11
programme.desc: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Meet nature's most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don't get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark's electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. programme.desc: Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moth's clever way of escaping hungry bats.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 2
programme.desc: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlotte's tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Face a tough decision when Esti's leg infection puts the brakes on this young duiker's release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: One uses a mustache to attract mates and another has a bill so big, it needs special vertebrae to carry it. Learn how nature's flying iconoclasts have evolved their appearance in order to survive.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

programme.title: Brazil Untamed Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanal's Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Join a group of wildlife scientists tracking the comeback of the ocelot in the Pantanal. Check in on their network of trail cameras, which capture the movements of this elusive spotted cat, and see the perils it faces, including giant anacondas.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that won't go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks she's a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Pride Rules Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein's defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs' lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions' camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Pride Rules Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe's banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Gawk at some of the world's ugliest animals who owe their survival to the adaptations that made them so strange. A pudgy wolf eel, naked mole rat, and hideous sea lamprey may be superficially grotesque, but they're evolutionarily amazing.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1
programme.desc: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Arabia's coral reefs are home to some of nature's most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can't resist.

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: It's summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

programme.title: Arabian Seas Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Zambia's Luangwa Valley is home to Africa's biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia Season 2 Episode 7
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to sur...

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand's Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands' massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.desc: Witness the tiny creatures that make us squirm while hiding admirable survival skills. From playing dead, removing a tail, or being able to lift objects 30 times their weight, these insects conquer the world with their amazing adaptations.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Get a sanitation lesson from nature's original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the world's unsung heroes.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride's nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China's land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.desc: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends Season 1 Episode 6

When they arrived in the Myanmar mountains however, they were betrayed by the Ghost King who decided to kill them instead. Hui shielded Qiang from bullets but fell off from the clif...

programme.title: 生万物 / This Thriving Land Episode 26
programme.desc: 天牛庙村首富之女宁绣绣出嫁当天被土匪绑架，父亲宁学祥舍不得卖地赎她，将她的妹妹宁苏苏嫁给她青梅竹马的恋人 ...Ning Xiu Xiu, the daughter of the richest man in Tianniu Temple Village, was kidnapped by bandits on her wedding day. Her father was reluctant to sell his land to redeem her, so he sent his younger daughter Ning Su Su to marry Xiu Xiu's childhood sweetheart instead, Xiu Xiu decisively severed her relationship with her father

programme.title: 人生只租不卖 / The Lives We Lease
programme.desc: 浑噩度日的何幸琪，因母亲的遗嘱，被迫与房管事务所所长程轩共同继承一栋高价房产，条件是她必须在事务所工作满一年。这家事务所专营包租业务，租赁管理师扮演着房东与房客之间的桥梁，每一次媒合任务都像一道人生选择题，引领幸琪走向自我价值的追寻之路。Drifting through life, Qi must work one year at a property management agency to jointly inherit a valuable property with its director Xuan, under her late mother’s will. As she mediates between landlords and tenants, each case becomes a step towards self-worth, growth, unexpected connections and transformation.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 168
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 巨塔之后 / The Queen Of Castle Episode 10
programme.desc: 明塱医院外科名医董一妍与医院主席王进涛在欧洲盛大圆婚，却不受王家众人的欢迎。婚礼翌日，进涛与儿孙一同坠机遇难，让王家与明塱集团顿时陷入混乱。眼看进涛的宿敌柯永成伺机搅局，一妍试图拉拢王家两个媳妇携手维持大局，却被怀疑与这场空难有关。面临内忧外患的她会如何在这场权力与利益的争夺战中胜出？Renowned surgeon Yan married her hospital’s chairman Tao in Europe, without the blessings from his family. The next day after the wedding, a fatal plane crash killed Tao and his heirs, leaving behind his two daughters-in-law. programme.title: 春家小姐是讼师 / Miss Chun Is a Litigator Episode 9
programme.desc:
少女春荼蘼生于军户之家，父亲被冤入狱后因家中无男丁，平时熟读律法的她不得不亲自上堂为父申冤，由此走上了状师之路。在春荼蘼的坚持和家人的鼓励下，她救贫民、斗权贵，不畏强权、狡猾多智，破获了各色疑难案件，最终成为了古代第一女状师。

少女春荼蘼生于军户之家，父亲被冤入狱后因家中无男丁，平时熟读律法的她不得不亲自上堂为父申冤，由此走上了状师之路。在春荼蘼的坚持和家人的鼓励下，她救贫民、斗权贵，不畏强权、狡猾多智，破获了各色疑难案件，最终成为了古代第一女状师。
Set in the Tang dynasty, the story revolves around Mi, the daughter of a military family who set out to clear her father's name, who was wrongly imprisoned. On her perseverance to help the poor against the rich and powerful, she gradually became an outstanding attorney who managed to resolve various difficult cases, earning the admiration of a few suiters. programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 91
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 949
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 巨塔之后 / The Queen Of Castle Episode 11
programme.desc: 明塱医院外科名医董一妍与医院主席王进涛在欧洲盛大圆婚，却不受王家众人的欢迎。婚礼翌日，进涛与儿孙一同坠机遇难，让王家与明塱集团顿时陷入混乱。眼看进涛的宿敌柯永成伺机搅局，一妍试图拉拢王家两个媳妇携手维持大局，却被怀疑与这场空难有关。面临内忧外患的她会如何在这场权力与利益的争夺战中胜出？Renowned surgeon Yan married her hospital’s chairman Tao in Europe, without the blessings from his family. The next day after the wedding, a fatal plane crash killed Tao and his heirs, leaving behind his two daughters-in-law. Branded a suspect and surrounded by rivals who are eyeing Tao’s company, Yan must manage her family’s internal power struggles a...

programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级夜总会 / Super Nightclub Episode 683
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 709
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 119
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 139
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 上山吧，台湾队 / To The Top: Team Taiwan Episode 13
programme.desc: 本节目不仅是一场体能与意志的极限挑战，更是结合台湾专业与精神之旅。这项挑战历时两年筹备，由艺人连同台湾体坛顶尖运动员，在180天内登顶欧、亚、非大陆的三大圣山：从欧洲有“阿尔卑斯圣杯”之称的瑞士马特洪峰，到海拔5,895公尺的非洲第一高峰吉力马札罗山，最终回归台湾险峻壮丽的“圣棱线”七座百岳连峰。Taking 2 years to prepare for, this is an outdoor adventure series that is more than an ultimate test of physical strength and willpower. Led by artistes, top Taiwanese athletes took a tough journey to scale 3 mountains across the European, African and Asian continents – from Matterhorn in Switzerland to Mt Kilimanjaro in Africa to the Holy Ridge...

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 950
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 169
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 人生只租不卖 / The Lives We Lease Episode 3
programme.desc: 浑噩度日的何幸琪，因母亲的遗嘱，被迫与房管事务所所长程轩共同继承一栋高价房产，条件是她必须在事务所工作满一年。这家事务所专营包租业务，租赁管理师扮演着房东与房客之间的桥梁，每一次媒合任务都像一道人生选择题，引领幸琪走向自我价值的追寻之路。Drifting through life, Qi must work one year at a property management agency to jointly inherit a valuable property with its director Xuan, under her late mother’s will. As she mediates between landlords and tenants, each case becomes a step towards self-worth, growth, unexpected connections and transformation.

programme.title: 白色橄榄树 / The White Olive Tree Episode 23
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 四方馆 / Go East Episode 3
programme.desc: 讲述了雍国外交机构“四方馆”里的元莫、阿术、王昆吾、尉迟华等四方志士并肩作战，携手成长，共同破解“四方迷局”的故事. A period drama with romance, comedy and intrigue focusing on Yuan Mo, an unofficial member of the Sifang Pavilion and the mysterious Shu, as they work together to prevent a sinister organization from inciting a war.

programme.title: 四方馆 / Go East Episode 4

programme.title: 玫瑰丛生 / About Love Episode 3
programme.desc: 《玫瑰丛生》讲述了鉴情师李晓兮和小贝之间的浪漫故事。李晓兮因职业原因对爱情充满恐惧，而小贝则是忠诚坚定的男人。两人在酒吧相遇后，李晓兮误将小贝当作鉴情对象，并在后续的接触中对他产生了感情。然而，由于职业经历，李晓兮对小贝的真心持怀疑态度，于是安排了十四个鉴情师对他进行试探。小贝在面对各种诱惑时始终不为所动。在相处过程中，小贝的忠诚和坚定逐渐打动了李晓兮，也帮助她克服了对爱情的不安全感。同时，李晓兮的陪伴和包容也让小贝治愈了心中的旧伤痛，学会了珍惜。This drama tells the story of a connoisseur, Xiao Xi, who acts as different characters to test men’s faithfulness in relationships, appearing to them in different roles to determine their true feelings to their partners.

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 17
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 四方馆 / Go East Episode 5
programme.desc: 讲述了雍国外交机构“四方馆”里的元莫、阿术、王昆吾、尉迟华等四方志士并肩作战，携手成长，共同破解“四方迷局”的故事. A period drama with romance, comedy and intrigue focusing on Yuan Mo, an unofficial member of the Sifang Pavilion and the mysterious Shu, as they work together to prevent a sinister organization from inciting a war.

programme.title: 凡人修仙传 / The Immortal Ascension
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事。Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. programme.title: 四方馆 / Go East Episode 5
programme.desc: 讲述了雍国外交机构“四方馆”里的元莫、阿术、王昆吾、尉迟华等四方志士并肩作战，携手成长，共同破解“四方迷局”的故事. A period drama with romance, comedy and intrigue focusing on Yuan Mo, an unofficial member of the Sifang Pavilion and the mysterious Shu, as they work together to prevent a sinister organization from inciting a war.

programme.title: 凡人修仙传 / The Immortal Ascension
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事。Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. Through his own hard work and perseverance, he overcomes strong and intense competition between immortal practitioners and finally attains immortal cultivation, becoming the proud conqueror of the three worlds!

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 19
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 突然的喜欢 / My Page in the 90s
programme.desc: 当2023年的情感主播进入到一本古早言情小说中，遇到了1998年的白切黑霸总，套路与反套路的终极对决，最终谁能胜出？为了回到熟悉的现实世界，情感主播邱欢儿开启了一系列攻略霸总高海明的操作，却聪明反被聪明误，当她用尽全力通关，必须离开书中世界时，却发现自己早已深陷其中，不舍离开。从“欲走还留”到“欲留还走”，故事的最后，有情人能否终成眷属…… When a 2025 love advice streamer gets pulled into a classic 1999 romance novel, she faces off against a cunning CEO with tricks of his own. To return to reality, Lin Huan Er tries every tactic to win over the cold-hearted Gao Hai Ming only to find herself falling for him.

programme.title: 突然的喜欢 / My Page in the 90s
programme.desc: 当2023年的情感主播进入到一本古早言情小说中，遇到了1998年的白切黑霸总，套路与反套路的终极对决，最终谁能胜出？为了回到熟悉的现实世界，情感主播邱欢儿开启了一系列攻略霸总高海明的操作，却聪明反被聪明误，当她用尽全力通关，必须离开书中世界时，却发现自己早已深陷其中，不舍离开。从“欲走还留”到“欲留还走”，故事的最后，有情人能否终成眷属…… When a 2025 love advice streamer gets pulled into a classic 1999 romance novel, she faces off against a cunning CEO with tricks of his own. To return to reality, Lin Huan Er tries every tactic to win over the cold-hearted Gao Hai Ming only to find herself falling for him.

programme.title: 凡人修仙传 / The Immortal Ascension Episode 3
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事。Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. Through his own hard work and perseverance, he overcomes strong and intense competition between immortal practitioners and finally attains immortal cultivation, becoming the proud conqueror of the three worlds!

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 21
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 白色橄榄树 / The White Olive Tree Episode 29
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 突然的喜欢 / My Page in the 90s Episode 3
programme.desc: 当2023年的情感主播进入到一本古早言情小说中，遇到了1998年的白切黑霸总，套路与反套路的终极对决，最终谁能胜出？为了回到熟悉的现实世界，情感主播邱欢儿开启了一系列攻略霸总高海明的操作，却聪明反被聪明误，当她用尽全力通关，必须离开书中世界时，却发现自己早已深陷其中，不舍离开。从“欲走还留”到“欲留还走”，故事的最后，有情人能否终成眷属…… When a 2025 love advice streamer gets pulled into a classic 1999 romance novel, she faces off against a cunning CEO with tricks of his own. To return to reality, Lin Huan Er tries every tactic to win over the cold-hearted Gao Hai Ming only to find herself falling for him.

programme.title: 凡人修仙传 / The Immortal Ascension Episode 5
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事。Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. Through his own hard work and perseverance, he overcomes strong and intense competition between immortal practitioners and finally attains immortal cultivation, becoming the proud conqueror of the three worlds!

Through his own hard work and perseverance, he overcomes strong and intense competition between immortal practitioners and finally attains immortal cultivation, becoming the proud conqueror of the three worlds!

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 23
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 白色橄榄树 / The White Olive Tree Episode 29
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 15
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 偷偷藏不住 / Hidden Love
programme.desc: 桑稚初中时期被老师频繁请家长，为了解决麻烦，桑稚找哥哥顶包，然而兄妹见面就互怼闹僵，无奈只好求助来家中玩耍的哥哥舍友段嘉许。在桑稚的苦求要挟下，段嘉许帮桑稚去学校见老师，两人因此结缘，段嘉许从此更是把桑稚当成自己的亲妹妹爱护。随着段嘉许大学毕业，两人分隔异地，关系疏远。直到成年后的桑稚如愿考到了段嘉许的城市，两人重逢。在日渐亲密的接触下，桑稚渐渐发现了段嘉许一直以来的压力来源，她想要保护这个一直对自己很好的大哥哥，重拾埋藏心底的暗恋。在桑稚的陪伴下，段嘉许慢慢解开心结，他真心喜欢上了长大的桑稚，一段纯真暗恋终于开出美丽的爱情花朵 。

programme.title: 消失的孩子 / The Disappearing Child Episode 7
programme.desc:
冬至清晨，杨远九岁的儿子在楼梯间消失无踪。他曾在失踪前一刻潜入邻居家中，但可疑的邻居却有不在场证明。同栋楼的的另一单位，袁午的父亲酒后猝亡。为了冒领退休金，袁午决定在出租屋藏匿父亲的尸体。半年前，独居的女白领林楚萍在家中醒来发现熟睡中被侵犯，而凶手却毫无头绪，只有窗台上留下的一块乙醚手帕。这些看似毫不相关的人，在不同时空里相互交叠，又在这一刻重新开始了关系 。

改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 偷偷藏不住 / Hidden Love
programme.desc: 桑稚初中时期被老师频繁请家长，为了解决麻烦，桑稚找哥哥顶包，然而兄妹见面就互怼闹僵，无奈只好求助来家中玩耍的哥哥舍友段嘉许。在桑稚的苦求要挟下，段嘉许帮桑稚去学校见老师，两人因此结缘，段嘉许从此更是把桑稚当成自己的亲妹妹爱护。随着段嘉许大学毕业，两人分隔异地，关系疏远。直到成年后的桑稚如愿考到了段嘉许的城市，两人重逢。在日渐亲密的接触下，桑稚渐渐发现了段嘉许一直以来的压力来源，她想要保护这个一直对自己很好的大哥哥，重拾埋藏心底的暗恋。在桑稚的陪伴下，段嘉许慢慢解开心结，他真心喜欢上了长大的桑稚，一段纯真暗恋终于开出美丽的爱情花朵 。

programme.title: 蛮好的人生 / A Better Life Episode 35
programme.desc: 三十九岁的保险从业人员胡曼黎在以为自己即将迎接人生巅峰之时，却同时失去了婚姻和工作。竞争对手暗中作梗，胡曼黎惨遭公司开除，而始作俑者竟是二十八岁的薛晓舟。胡曼黎在与薛晓舟几番交手后，他们逐渐从误解到相互认同，胡曼黎决定不计前嫌和薛晓舟联手合作，从头再来。薛晓舟成长为保险业界不容小觑的金牌销冠，胡曼黎也决定回归自己的事业主场。 Hu Man Li, a thirty-nine-year-old insurance practitioner, lost her marriage and job at the same time when she thought she was about to reach the peak of her life. programme.title: 消失的孩子 / The Disappearing Child Episode 7
programme.desc:
冬至清晨，杨远九岁的儿子在楼梯间消失无踪。他曾在失踪前一刻潜入邻居家中，但可疑的邻居却有不在场证明。同栋楼的的另一单位，袁午的父亲酒后猝亡。为了冒领退休金，袁午决定在出租屋藏匿父亲的尸体。半年前，独居的女白领林楚萍在家中醒来发现熟睡中被侵犯，而凶手却毫无头绪，只有窗台上留下的一块乙醚手帕。这些看似毫不相关的人，在不同时空里相互交叠，又在这一刻重新开始了关系 。

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 17
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 偷偷藏不住 / Hidden Love Episode 3
programme.desc: 桑稚初中时期被老师频繁请家长，为了解决麻烦，桑稚找哥哥顶包，然而兄妹见面就互怼闹僵，无奈只好求助来家中玩耍的哥哥舍友段嘉许。在桑稚的苦求要挟下，段嘉许帮桑稚去学校见老师，两人因此结缘，段嘉许从此更是把桑稚当成自己的亲妹妹爱护。随着段嘉许大学毕业，两人分隔异地，关系疏远。直到成年后的桑稚如愿考到了段嘉许的城市，两人重逢。在日渐亲密的接触下，桑稚渐渐发现了段嘉许一直以来的压力来源，她想要保护这个一直对自己很好的大哥哥，重拾埋藏心底的暗恋。在桑稚的陪伴下，段嘉许慢慢解开心结，他真心喜欢上了长大的桑稚，一段纯真暗恋终于开出美丽的爱情花朵 。

programme.desc: 桑稚初中时期被老师频繁请家长，为了解决麻烦，桑稚找哥哥顶包，然而兄妹见面就互怼闹僵，无奈只好求助来家中玩耍的哥哥舍友段嘉许。在桑稚的苦求要挟下，段嘉许帮桑稚去学校见老师，两人因此结缘，段嘉许从此更是把桑稚当成自己的亲妹妹爱护。随着段嘉许大学毕业，两人分隔异地，关系疏远。直到成年后的桑稚如愿考到了段嘉许的城市，两人重逢。在日渐亲密的接触下，桑稚渐渐发现了段嘉许一直以来的压力来源，她想要保护这个一直对自己很好的大哥哥，重拾埋藏心底的暗恋。在桑稚的陪伴下，段嘉许慢慢解开心结，他真心喜欢上了长大的桑稚，一段纯真暗恋终于开出美丽的爱情花朵 。

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 25
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 白色橄榄树 / The White Olive Tree Episode 31
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 今生也是第一次 / For The First Time In My Life
programme.desc:
剧集跳转三段时空，在同一间妇产医院里，围绕三对夫妻展开的关于生育、婚姻，事业与家庭的故事。1993年的戴思瑾和路明磊在体制和市场变革的压力下寻求抓手；2008年的陈兰青和程领先，虽为人父母，内心却未长大成人，只得在妈妈和婆婆的夹缝中艰难生存；2022年的路远方和夏志雄面对生活逐渐失控，领悟到唯有与自己和解才能到达彼岸。
Spanning across three different eras in the same maternity hospital, the story revolves around three couples regarding their childbirth, marriage, career and family. In 1993, a woman and her new-born were abandoned at the hospital by her husband, with a huge debt. In 2008, a new mother who was still a child at heart, was trapped be...

programme.title: 七根心简 / The Seven Relics of Ill Omen
programme.desc: 上古陨铁带来七个能寄生人体、引人作恶的异物。大德以神木制成“七根心简”并封印。百年后心简重现，离奇凶案频发。木代、罗韧、炎红砂、一万三、曹严华五位热血青年组成“凤凰小分队”，踏上收服凶简之旅。In ancient times, a meteorite descended on earth and brought along seven mysterious creatures which could parasitize humans, interfere consciousness, and lead to evil. To subdue these forces, a master crafted seven wooden tablets from a sacred tree and named them the “Seven Heart Tablets”, and locks were forged to seal the tablets. programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 25
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 国色芳华第一季 / Flourished Peony Season 1
programme.desc: 本剧以唐朝为背景，讲述了一名女子由牡丹培育而起，终达经世济民、匡扶天下的传奇励志故事。商户之女何惟芳，在雅冠长安的“天下第一贪官"(花鸟使)蒋长扬的协助下，从只有利益交换的婚姻中和离出户。京城二人再度偶遇，何惟芳凭借培育稀世牡丹的高超技能和过人的经商头脑与蒋长扬组成匠人与投资人的组合，她从培育牡丹起家，带领一众命运坎坷的女性共同经营花坊，打造品牌。何惟芳渐渐发现这位一身骂名的“花鸟使”实则是外浪内纯，藏巧于拙、心怀天下的国之利刃。亲睹寒门学子，劳苦百姓生活之艰，何惟芳决心转型利民实业。在蒋长扬的报国之路上，何惟芳屡屡从旁帮助，双方渐渐暗生情愫。经历九死一生，二人携手共平叛乱，双双退隐天地间 It tells the legendary and inspirational story in Tang Dynasty, about the protagonists who started their own business by cultivating peonies and ended up helping the people and the world. programme.title: 国色芳华第一季 / Flourished Peony Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: 蒋长扬随县主一行人前来参加刘家花宴，刘申向县主炫耀自家的牡丹花，县主一听是情敌种的花，立马想要一朵，刘申想摘花被何惟芳及时拦住，称花是父母的嫁妆。刘畅劝县主算了，县主却偏要，何惟芳只得用商贾身份自黑。众人嘲笑她，刘畅也嫌她丢脸，但她只想保住母亲的遗物，心中无所畏惧。现场只有蒋长扬看出了她的心思。

programme.title: 白色橄榄树 / The White Olive Tree Episode 33
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉。李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良。相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花。然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符。回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系。李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛。机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子。

programme.title: 国色芳华第一季 / Flourished Peony Season 1
programme.desc: 本剧以唐朝为背景，讲述了一名女子由牡丹培育而起，终达经世济民、匡扶天下的传奇励志故事。商户之女何惟芳，在雅冠长安的“天下第一贪官"(花鸟使)蒋长扬的协助下，从只有利益交换的婚姻中和离出户。京城二人再度偶遇，何惟芳凭借培育稀世牡丹的高超技能和过人的经商头脑与蒋长扬组成匠人与投资人的组合，她从培育牡丹起家，带领一众命运坎坷的女性共同经营花坊，打造品牌。何惟芳渐渐发现这位一身骂名的“花鸟使”实则是外浪内纯，藏巧于拙、心怀天下的国之利刃。亲睹寒门学子，劳苦百姓生活之艰，何惟芳决心转型利民实业。在蒋长扬的报国之路上，何惟芳屡屡从旁帮助，双方渐渐暗生情愫。经历九死一生，二人携手共平叛乱，双双退隐天地间 It tells the legendary and inspirational story in Tang Dynasty, about the protagonists who started their own business by cultivating peonies and ended up helping the people and the world. programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 302
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 青春本我 / Forever Young At Heart Episode 5
programme.desc: 第十集 青春校园祭 礼堂内，学生如临大敌应考。派卷日，每人都要升一个grade才可保住校园祭，最后领取成绩单的Archie战战兢兢……校园祭如期举行，师生都悉心打扮参加，角逐「最佳造型奖」，还纷纷投入舞池。善美打扮美丽动人，深深吸引了叶坤。善美在学院服务的最后一天，朱校监前来送别，并说起当年有女学生意图轻生一事。善美回顾各「重点学生」的成长档案，感到安慰。善美踏出学院大门时，学生出现送别，依依不舍……

programme.title: Holistic way+京都念慈庵:正义女神 & 今日知多D / Themis & What's On Today Episode 2
programme.desc: 第2集 惠知赶往现场，目睹宇泽的母亲苏丽慈持刀挟持成彬，事态逐渐失控……一年后，惠知放弃升职，主动调迁少年法庭，更因此与光正离婚。工作严谨的惠知，与轻松的裁判法院法官们格格不入。海滨公园内，满身鲜血的姚振铭，向路经的裁判官郑邵文称砍伤了姊姊和妹妹。父亲认定振铭是妒忌姊姊得到偏爱而犯案，辩方律师程睿燊以振铭有精神问题抗辩。感化官郑邵玲认为振铭的姊弟关系其实不错，惠知要求邵文上庭作证，让振铭道出真相……

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1771
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 90
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 奢游记 / Journey To The Wealthy West Episode 2
programme.desc:
第2集 逾百年佳酿珍藏、比华利山顶级豪宅
晨芝、衍峰拜访一位酒收藏家。打开木箱套装，内藏法国九大顶级酒庄的2003年珍酿，一箱已价值连城，收藏家却透露自己拥有十多箱；他再展示三支珍藏，全是 1918 年出产，价值难以估算。
两主持体验无人驾驶电召车，试乘后有何评价？再参观比华利山山顶最昂贵地段的豪宅，市值约三千五百万美元。大宅设有无边际泳池、影院、健身房、保险库等，还可俯瞰洛杉矶，尽显奢华。
衍峰为试图贴近上述生活，决定透过加州彩票买个希望。

programme.title: 春闺梦里人 / Romance of A Twin Flower Episode 6
programme.desc: 第19集 袁朗将季曼带到花灯节并给季曼送花表达情意，被季曼以兄弟情谊委婉拒绝，不过这一幕恰巧被看到宁钰轩顿时吃起醋；袁朗宁钰轩在花灯节套圈摊位为了季曼互相比拼。于此同时，水娘子为鬼白放花灯，又扮鬼脸逗鬼白开心，鬼白坚硬内心被温暖……正当大家在花灯节玩的开心之时，突然皓雪堂仓库起了大火！众人赶回救火，宁钰轩不惜为了季曼冒着自己内心怕火的禁忌奋勇救火晕倒，虽然众人奋力扑救，但皓雪堂仓库已烧去大半，这一烧让皓雪堂元气大伤。深夜，宁钰轩从昏迷中醒来，两人互诉衷肠，关系修复如初，更胜从前，而宁钰轩更向季曼说出了聂桑榆已经死去的事情。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 65
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 大梦想家 / Big Big Home Episode 9
programme.desc: 新楼华丽时尚，可省却不少装潢烦恼。旧屋只要多花心思，也可换上耳目一新的感觉。主持谭凯萤游走台湾各地，深入市区黄金地段、新市镇发展潜力区域，探寻气派不凡的豪宅别墅与特色家居，细看《大梦想家》！移居台湾的港人，如何实现置业与创业梦想？多位「梦想家」分享当地的买楼故事与生活指南。导演赖丰奇、台裔美籍歌手荣忠豪、艺人杨子黎、音乐制作人陈宏佳、来自加拿大的「中文计算机之父」刘力学等，也会在节目中公开安乐窝。

programme.title: 机智女法医2 & 今日知多D / Imperial Coroner, The (II) & What's On Today Episode 19
programme.desc: 第23集 玉澜满脸忧虑，称昨晚柳刺史饮酒后独自出门，到深夜都没回来。韩绩却在一旁满不在乎，觉得柳刺史是怕担责故意跑掉。萧瑾瑜察觉到韩绩和玉澜间气氛微妙，当下便与楚楚一道，带人去寻柳刺史踪迹。在一片幽深的竹林中，他们发现了柳刺史的尸体。尸体趴伏在地，身上插满了尖锐的竹笋，周围还散落着一些诡异的虫子，这些虫子竟拼出了“交州恶地，万灵既灭，新王不立，生机不存”的字样。萧瑾瑜等人面色凝重，返回后，楚楚指出柳刺史的死状异常，若真是醉酒摔落，理应会有挣扎的痕迹，而非如此平静。楚楚凑近细瞧那些虫子，发觉并非普通种类，隐隐还透着毒性。

programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: Holistic way+京都念慈庵:正义女神 / Themis Episode 3
programme.desc: 第3集 邵文处理一宗家暴案，勾起自身回忆；童年的邵文与姊姊邵玲饱受母亲毒打，邵玲为保护弟弟大义灭亲。邵玲这次希望邵文的判决可令案中施暴父亲付出代价，但事情其后出现变量……邵玲对邵文的判决感到不解，姊弟关系降至冰点。离岛三少年在山头活埋同学，此案由惠知接手审理。淑桦为其中一名被告辩护，提出三人只是受岛上恶霸谈卓飞唆摆作恶，犯案主谋应是卓飞。惠知、淑桦再次交锋，二人都想起因丽慈母子而起的往事……

programme.title: 机智女法医2 / Imperial Coroner, The (II) Episode 20
programme.desc: 第20集 萧瑾瑜留意到院子里的一群鸽子，不禁向楚河询问起它们的来历。楚河解释道，这些鸽子是前任掌柜所养，他接手后便继续留了下来，没想到佑辰安似乎对它们颇为喜爱，时常前来逗弄。萧瑾瑜听后，又问起前掌柜的情况，楚河表示自己仅见过前掌柜一面，不过记得他身边常伴一位女子，虽身着中原服饰，但面容却透着南赵人的特征。萧瑾瑜心中一动，暗想这些鸽子或许正是佑辰安与外界联系的媒介，便嘱咐楚河好好照料它们。此前，萧瑾瑜已与齐大夫等人讨论过王妃所中之毒，并广邀名医前来会诊，遗憾的是，无人识得此毒。齐大夫提出，既然已知毒药种类，或许能在毒药生长之地寻得解药线索。当前，他们只能先用药稳住王妃的心脉，只是这药价格昂贵。萧瑾瑜毫不犹豫地吩咐连翘将府中银两悉数取出，若不够，便变卖家产，也要救回王妃。

programme.title: 奢游记 / Journey To The Wealthy West Episode 3
programme.desc:
第3集 名车收藏、珠宝设计追梦故事 有收藏家十岁开始对某名车品牌情有独钟，继而养成收集兴趣，甚至参与改装设计。两主持深入其私人车库，一探其追梦之旅。珍藏中亦有两支获知名乐团亲笔签名的结他，有何深刻点滴？晨芝还应嘉宾邀请外出兜风，感受名车魅力。
在香港长大的珠宝设计师勇闯美国发展，曾与不同国际巨星合作。嘉宾难忘籍籍无名时获当地女星鼓励，也遇过巨星遗失借用首饰的状况？主持揭开珠宝背后的星光故事，晨芝还抢先试戴专为天后设计的「重量级」耳环。

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA Episode 705
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 世界观 / Global View
programme.desc: 由资深新闻工作者负责的《世界观》，带你用世界观、观世界，更阔更广看新闻、长知识。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 303
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 青春本我 / Forever Young At Heart Episode 6
programme.desc: 第十集 青春校园祭 礼堂内，学生如临大敌应考。派卷日，每人都要升一个grade才可保住校园祭，最后领取成绩单的Archie战战兢兢……校园祭如期举行，师生都悉心打扮参加，角逐「最佳造型奖」，还纷纷投入舞池。善美打扮美丽动人，深深吸引了叶坤。善美在学院服务的最后一天，朱校监前来送别，并说起当年有女学生意图轻生一事。善美回顾各「重点学生」的成长档案，感到安慰。善美踏出学院大门时，学生出现送别，依依不舍……
